correctness.rationale: Cauchy–Binet identifies the section with the restricted Gram determinant. Exact local ideal equality follows from adjugate identities; its support is corank at least two. An isotropic-radical incidence fibration gives smooth strata and codimension r(r+1)/2, with dimension-three threshold at r=2. The Gram-deformation map is surjective on Sym^2(R*), giving determinant normal slices, A1 along r=2, and closure of higher-r strata. OGr(2,n) connected/irreducible n>=5; OGr(2,4) two classical components. Exact arithmetic checks independently verified six local identities and dimension profiles, not used as proof.

value.rationale: Gives exact global geometry of the singular locus of a naturally defined Plücker quadric, upgrading a published dimension-dependent bound to the constant sharp three for all interior Grassmannians. It also classifies the exceptional component split and uniform ordinary-double-point transverse singularities, geometrically clarifying a singular base locus directly relevant to ED critical equations. These are structural infinite-family facts, not a finite parameter increment or trivial sign check.
